primary_contract: IHACPA source archive provenance manifest, acquisition script, raw-storage policy, and explicit Box-hosted gap handling

included: Tracked manifest schema and helper types for IHACPA source artifacts.
Fixture-backed IHACPA calculators page parsing and list/download workflow.
Raw archive exclusion policy with tracked provenance output paths.
Explicit lifecycle axes for acquisition, extraction, implementation, and validation.
Box-hosted share-page outcomes recorded as acquisition gaps instead of completed downloads.
excluded: Redistribution of licensed raw IHACPA calculator binaries in normal Git history.
Claiming extracted, implemented, or validated calculator parity for every archived source.
Recovering direct binaries for Box-hosted gaps without a separately approved source.

gap_register.description: The 2021-22 and 2022-23 SAS links resolved to Box HTML share pages or inaccessible links; the provenance layer records these as explicit gaps until a verified binary source is available.
